about_the_game:
Demo Description

The Demo contains levels where you activate contraptions at the right timing to either stop the bad guys, like smashing them using huge Hammers, or activate contraptions to help the good guys reach the exit gates!

Full game Description

Welcome to Crafty Crasher!

The ultimate crash playground full of contrations & chaos!

Trigger traps and gadgets with perfect timing to blast or rescue vehicles—then twist the scene into glorious mayhem by moving parts around or crafting your own wacky contraptions!

Smash or Save – It’s Up to You!

  • Perfect Timing! Flip switches and hit buttons at just the right moment to help the good guys escape… or stop the bad guys as fast as you can!

  • Wild Stunts! Launch cars off giant ramps, hurl them through obstacles, and watch them either stick the landing or crash in spectacular fashion!

  • Wacky Contraptions! Use springboards, hammers, spinning blades, and more to trigger wild chain reactions full of surprises!

Unleash Your Creativity!

  • Craft the Chaos! Build your own cars, characters, and crazy machines with a fun cartoony 3D modeling system.

  • Full Sandbox Freedom! Rearrange anything—blocks, gadgets, traps, physics toys—and design your ultimate crash scene.

  • Slow-Mo Destruction! Enjoy every bounce, break, and blast in glorious slow motion!

Join the Crash Craft Community!

  • Let's build a great community to play endless custom levels made by other players—there will always be something wild and new to try!

  • Challenge Your Friends! Share your trickiest scenes and see who can survive your madness or outsmart your builds!

  • Show Off Your Mayhem! Post your most jaw-dropping crashes and funniest fails to entertain (or impress) the community!

Wishlist Now

Wishlist Crafty Crasher now, and try the Demo very soon! Let's get ready to smash, and laugh your way through the wackiest creative sandbox ever built!
